newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Canada's Martin welcomes employment numbers.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Martin welcomes employment numbers.

text.p: Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin said on Friday he was pleased but not surprised by good March employment numbers.
"I'm obviously very pleased. We've had very strong (economic) numbers in Canada for quite some time now," Martin told Reuters Financial Television in an interview.
He was commenting on announcement earlier on Friday from Canada that unemployment declined to 9.3 percent in March from 9.7 percent in February.
The data also showed employment rising by 60,900, its biggest gain since August 1996.
Martin said productivity figures, export growth and other economic indicators in recent months had been showing strength.
"There's obviously a lag time in terms of increase in employment," Martin said.
"In fact, I expected this for some time."
Martin is in the Philippines for a meeting of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation forum.
